summary: Executed backend + frontend regression on public preview. Verified hero image rollout/responsiveness, audience preselection links, page smoke, FAQ, contact validation, and backend Gmail notification + Mongo persistence. Found mobile menu accessibility/interaction bugs and observed rate-limit behavior can be flaky across sequential runs in shared ingress conditions.

minor.issue: Rate-limit six-request sequence was flaky across runs (first run all 200s, retry produced 429+Retry-After). Recent active hashed keys observed: 26b6802dfe170dc19e53113a299553f6b77d269ebc9739084e51d40ca338c759 and eed1b3307d41592e1bd79b0483c05bc01c422691e47684b3b0931a7e040bb4a9, indicating multiple source identities in shared ingress traffic.

ui_bugs.issue: Escape key did not close mobile sheet; menu remained visible after Escape in repeated checks.
Mobile services nav link became non-clickable in automation ('Element is outside viewport') while sheet is open.

integration_issues.issue: Could not reliably automate hidden honeypot-driven success state because hidden field is non-editable in UI context; full real-submit UI success not rerun to avoid extra real notification.

action_items: Fix mobile menu Escape close behavior (focus-trap/sheet close handling).
Fix mobile menu link clickability/viewport handling for in-drawer nav links.
Re-validate rate-limit identity strategy under shared ingress so six sequential requests from one client identity deterministically hit 429 on request 6.
critical_code_review_comments: Real contact submission now persisted with email_notification='sent', non-empty email_id, and notification_recipient='anuyora@gmail.com' (validated in Mongo).
TTL index exists on rate_limits.expires_at with expireAfterSeconds=0.
Public contact info remains contact@anuyora.com in frontend constants, while owner alerts use Gmail fallback in backend env.
No interactive elements missing data-testid across tested routes (/ , /services, /how-we-work, /about, /contact); no duplicate data-testid detected in tested pages.
seed_data_creation: Created QA records via API tests (status checks, one real enquiry, honeypot submissions).
context_for_next_testing_agent: One real submission already used in this iteration: enquiry_id 2309770a-b74d-45b2-8d04-9bb1a4d58aab with email_id 01a0e832-5602-7368-a689-42b6629352fb and recipient anuyora@gmail.com. Avoid extra real sends; use honeypot for limiter tests. Mobile menu Escape and nav click issues were reproducible in Playwright mobile viewport.
rca of the issue: Mobile menu issue likely in Sheet/dialog keyboard-close/focus handling on current implementation; Escape did not transition open state to false during test runs. Rate-limit inconsistency likely tied to request.client.host identity varying under shared ingress (multiple hashed limiter keys active), causing occasional all-200 six-request sequences before retry produced expected 429.
